annotations.text: How to pick: each board shows five directions, A–E, with my recommendation shaded. Reply with a letter per board — E1 A, E2 A, E3 A+C, E4 A — and any notes. Your notes outrank the recommendation; each pick becomes a rule in Admin.md §6.5 before any code.

Not on these boards: the nine prop types that already have a control (the table on the Read-first board). The thumbnails on the Illustration board are a stand-in field; the real picker draws each family with the generator in the node's hue.
